name: Salem Erode Investments Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1931, Salem Erode Investments Ltd (SEIL) is in lending business as an NBFC
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
On 17th February 2020, company was acquired by ICL Fincorp Limited which is a Non Banking Financial Company providing Gold Loan, Business Loan, Hire Purchase Loan, etc. After acquisition, company expanded its business and now has 12 branches in Southern India. ICL Fincorp Ltd holds 75% stake in SEIL. Company focuses on Gold Loans.

cons: Stock is trading at 2.77 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -9.14% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
